title: Traditional Food Environment and Factors Affecting Indigenous Food Consumption in Munda Tribal Community of Jharkhand, India
license: CC BY; publisher article text, not interview transcripts
source_status: existing candidate; do not assign new source identity until MMSC reconciliation

study_scope.geography: nine villages in Murhu and Torpa blocks, Khunti district, Jharkhand
study_scope.methods: nine focus group discussions and six key-informant interviews; local Mundari-speaking field workers

exact_html_section_candidates.locator: Materials and Methods > Study Locale and Population; Study Design
exact_html_section_candidates.proposition: The authors conducted qualitative enquiries in nine villages in two Khunti blocks.

exact_html_section_candidates.locator: Results > Indigenous Foods of Munda Tribal Community > Types of IFs Based on Free Listing
exact_html_section_candidates.proposition: Study participants collectively listed 194 indigenous foods in the free-listing exercise.

exact_html_section_candidates.locator: Results > Indigenous Foods of Munda Tribal Community > Classification of IFs Based on Preference
exact_html_section_candidates.proposition: Of the 194 listed foods, the authors classified 87 as commonly consumed and 107 as little-used or historically consumed.

exact_html_section_candidates.locator: Results > Indigenous Foods of Munda Tribal Community > Taxonomic Classification
exact_html_section_candidates.proposition: The study reports taxonomic identification for 156 of 194 listed foods.

exact_html_section_candidates.locator: Results > Indigenous Foods of Munda Tribal Community > Nutritive Values of IFs
exact_html_section_candidates.proposition: Nutrient values for 60 foods were drawn from secondary literature and 42 were assessed in the study laboratory.
